info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v4-spec
info.description: The Credit Check Retrieval API provides businesses with a seamless way to access credit card application data. This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed credit check information associated with credit card applications. Typical consumers include financial institutions and risk assessment teams needing to assess customer creditworthiness. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and streamline credit evaluation workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve credit check information associated with applications. It provides a comprehensive overview of the credit status and is essential for decision-making in the application process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for initiating a credit check operation. Please ensure that the request adheres to the expected structure defined in the schema.

200.description: Credit check request completed successfully, returning the results.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This schema represents the request body for the credit check operation in the applications service.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the credit check operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the credit check request.

resultId.description: The ID associated with the result of the credit check.

state.description: The current state of the credit check.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the credit check in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the credit check request.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: Response schema for the credit check operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the credit check.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the credit check was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the credit check was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details for tracking the credit check request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
